layouts.section_1_company: Grid 1x2 for intro, flowing into a 3-column grid for values. Timeline highlight placed symmetrically.

instructions_to_main_agent: WIPE ANY EXISTING DARK THEME TOKENS. This is a light 'premium industrial' site. Background is white/porcelain (#FDFDFD), text is graphite (#181A1C), accent is muted champagne gold (#CBA365).
Use Outfit for Headings and Manrope for Body. Use JetBrains Mono for small technical labels (like 'EST. 1984' or placeholder tags).
Navbar MUST use translucent white glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl with a bg-white/85 and subtle border-b. Ensure mobile menu collapses elegantly.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs).
Use Framer Motion for scroll reveals (y:40 to y:0, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]). DO NOT over-animate. Keep it composed and restrained.
Unconfirmed content (like missing photos, fake certificates, or filler text) MUST include the `[PLACEHOLDER — FOR OWNER REVIEW]` tag visually overlaid.
The inquiry form should have 10 fields. Use shadcn forms, inputs, selects, checkboxes.
Ensure 'Make an Inquiry' on Service cards prefills the form's service select dropdown via state.
Use rounded-none or rounded-sm for a precise, machined engineering feel, rather than soft SaaS bubbles. NO extreme border-radius.
Do NOT use transparent navigation backgrounds that make text unreadable. Use solid or highly opaque blurred backgrounds.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, especially with glassmorphism.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Keep text flow natural.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on provided image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
